newsitem.title: USA: Vintage champagne bubbles up - only at 35,000 feet.
newsitem.headline: Vintage champagne bubbles up - only at 35,000 feet.

text.p: Champagne lovers with a taste for one vintage bubbly will have to go to some extraordinary lengths - or heights - this month to quench their thirst.
During December, United Airlines will serve first-class passengers on its international flights some 7,000 bottles of 1990 Cuvee Dom Perignon.
The flights will be the only place in North America where the newest vintage of the heady French wine is available, at least until the new year, said a United spokesman.

Although the 35,000-foot-altitude apparently has little effect on the famed bubbles in the sparkling wine, high-fliers might find it tastes a little different than it does at sea level because of the dry cabin air during flight, he said.
The airline, which has had a partnership with the French champagne producer since 1991, serves a total of 84,000 bottles of Dom Perignon each year.
